verdict.detail: Discogs lists 2 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

physical: Pressed by CBS Pressing Plant, Aston Clinton

notes.text:
Issued in a single pocket gloss sleeve.
Printed inner sleeve with lyrics. This is top opening matte paper. 
'Home Taping Is Killing Music' logo in the lower left corner of the sleeve rear.
Some copies may have a fold-out poster and a corresponding hype sticker.

Catalogue numbers:
CBS 85941 on labels
85941 on sleeve and inner sleeve

All songs © 1982 G. Tipton Ltd., R. Halford Ltd. and K. Downing Ltd. except "(Take These) Chains" Copyright © 1981 Unart Music Corporation.

© 1982 CBS Inc. / ℗ 1982 CBS Inc.
Made in England

"From an unknown land and through distant skies came a winged warrior. Nothing remained sacred, no one was safe from the Hellion as it uttered its battle cry... Screaming For Vengeance."
